description: Golden cross-language vector for the FROZEN device-capability-snapshot content hash (PR 6.1a). capability_hash = sha256( domain_prefix || RFC-8785-JCS(snapshot) ), where snapshot has NO capability_hash field. A Python producer/verifier (4.3c/6.2) MUST reproduce canonical_json + capability_hash byte-for-byte. Lives OUTSIDE v1/ so the v1 conformance roster is unaffected.

number_canonicalization_vectors.description: RFC-8785 / ES6 Number->String conformance for the number-valued fields of a snapshot (e.g. target_position_m). Each `raw` JSON number MUST canonicalize to the string `canonical`. A naive Python producer using json.dumps DIVERGES on every case that carries `python_json_dumps` (giving a DIFFERENT capability_hash across languages) and MUST instead use a compliant JCS library. capability-hash.spec.ts (TS) asserts every case; the future Python producer/verifier (4.3c/6.2) MUST assert them too. This table does not affect the snapshot or capability_hash above.
